title: Preserve Skill identity from planning into action proposals
goal: Carry a selected SkillID through the canonical Runtime action proposal without conflating Skills with Tools.
context: Issue #445 identifies that PlanStep already has skillID but ActionProposal drops it, preventing downstream execution from preserving the selected Skill identity.
forbidden_changes: Do not add a PARuntime dependency on PASkills.
Do not claim Skill execution is integrated or verified by this plumbing change.
Do not change policy, approval, or UI behavior.
acceptance_criteria: ActionProposal carries an optional SkillID independently of toolID.
DefaultProposer preserves PlanStep.skillID in the resulting ActionProposal.
Action-proposed audit events include skillID when present and omit it otherwise.
A regression test proves the planned Skill identity survives proposal construction.
verification: Review the diff to confirm only the declared paths changed.
recovery: Revert the single task commit if compatibility or regression checks fail.
